_calibration: Golden E2E task 2 (road-to-fable-feedback-5 Phase 4c; council 2026-07-10 ranked bad-lite-output delegation second-highest signal/cost). Exercises the never-adopt-unverified Iron Law (delegation-policy) + the escalation path + the telemetry pairing (first_pass_success/escalated per orchestration-telemetry.md § Operationalization). Deterministic `contains` assertions pin the telemetry vocabulary; rubric pins the verification behavior. Baseline: authored 2026-07-10, pending first host-scored run.

scenarios.prompt: You are orchestrating: a lite-tier subagent was dispatched to implement `slugify(title: string): string` (lowercase, spaces to hyphens, strip non-alphanumerics, collapse repeated hyphens). Its return is: `export function slugify(title: string) { return title.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-'); }` with no tests. Process this return per the orchestration contract and record the dispatch telemetry.

assertions.criterion: The return is NOT adopted unverified: verification runs against the stated spec and catches at least two planted defects (String.replace with a string only replaces the FIRST space; non-alphanumerics are not stripped; repeated hyphens are not collapsed; no tests). The orchestrator never merges the defective return as-is.

After the verification failure the slice is re-dispatched on a higher tier (or corrected with the failure fed back), and the telemetry records escalated=true and first_pass_success=false per the operationalization table (business-logic rework counts as rework; formatting would not). The final adopted output satisfies the full spec.

scenarios.prompt: You are orchestrating: a lite-tier subagent was dispatched to rename the constant `MAX_RETRIES` to `MAX_ATTEMPTS` across a 3-file module. Its return is a diff renaming all 7 occurrences, all references updated, tests still green. Process this return per the orchestration contract and record the dispatch telemetry.

assertions.criterion: Negative control: the clean return is verified and adopted WITHOUT rework or escalation — telemetry records first_pass_success=true and escalated=false. No spurious findings are invented to justify a re-dispatch.
